runtime.bundleLoop: cd desktop && node build/next/index.ts bundle --minify, cp -R desktop/out-vscode/. <app>/Contents/Resources/app/out/, CARET_HOST_NODE=... bun scripts/build-caret.ts --package
runtime.drivers: CDP (renderer state + tab/pane geometry) and Computer Use @oai/sky (real clicks, AX tree)

problem: changes and file were editor-group tabs: the strip ran workbench.action.agentSessions.newChangesTab and workbench.action.quickOpen, so their surface landed in the editor group outside the panel.
In an empty window both commands resolve without opening anything, so the two entries looked dead and the rail had nothing to mark for them.

change.patch: patches/desktop/0021-caret-agent-home-utility.patch (folded in, not a later patch: 0021 creates these files, so a follow-up patch could not pass its own reverse-check)
change.model: AppsPanelTabKind = terminal | browser | changes | file; createChanges()/createFiles() are single-instance (the window owns one active session and one workspace, so a second tab would show the same surface twice) and return the open tab on a repeat request
change.pane: LAUNCHERS carry `hosted` only (no commandId); createHostedPaneView() builds the two bodies; activateTab/layoutActiveInstance drive focus and layout; the rail's active mark moved from renderTabs into applyActiveTab so a switch to an open pane updates it

hostedSurfaces.changes: ChangesViewPane (the base's changes view) inside a PaneView; the panel calls pane.render() because no view container does
hostedSurfaces.file: EmptyFileEditor (the base's Files tab content: empty state + Search Files), created against the panel's editor group
hostedSurfaces.notHosted: the file tree stays the base's Files view - IExplorerService.registerView() keeps one `view` slot, so a second explorer in the panel would take it over from the window's own

rail File: tabs [Changes, File], rail marks File, pane body 'Files / Select a file from the Files view / Search Files Cmd-P'
rail Changes again: switches in place, still two tabs
rail Browser: tabs [Changes, File, Browser], rail marks Browser, hosted browser with its address bar
after all four: the editor group still holds exactly one tab, 'Apps', and the group title strip is display:none - no Changes/File editor tabs
realInput: AX tree of the Agents window: rail = 4 toggle buttons Changes/Browser/Terminal/File + Open new tab menu + Toggle Pinned Summary; menu bar has no Selection/Go/Run/Terminal

real clicks rail Changes then Browser: switches between a hosted pane and the hosted browser in both directions
bugsFixedDuringVerification: the rail's active mark was only written in renderTabs, so switching to an already-open pane left the mark on the previous pane; it is written in applyActiveTab now
a hosted ViewPane rendered an empty shell until the panel called pane.render(); a view container does that before handing a pane to its PaneView
